GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT - Release Date Trailer
Suit up for humanity in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, landing March 5, 2027. Pre-order now: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/gundam-rogue-orbit-pre-order/9P4K0J8ZGT7V
 
As the ace pilot of the Gundam Helix your mission is to face the apocalypse, take control and jump into fast and hard-hitting melee combat. Every fight rewards skill, mastery, and quick, decisive action as you push your Gundam to its limits. 
 
The cinematic story of GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT is a daring new chapter in the GUNDAM saga, built as the perfect entry point for new players and a thrilling evolution for longtime fans.

FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE - Demo Trailer
Get an early look at the world, combat, and story of the first FINAL FANTASY adventure presented in stunning HD-2D graphics!

The free demo is available now on XBOX Series X|S. Continue your adventure by carrying over your demo saved data to the full game when it releases on October 22, 2026.

Begin your journey in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, experiencing the story from the opening through the end of Chapter 1. Engage in evolved turn-based battles and harness the power of Visions as they fight alongside your party.

Fall Up - Announcement and Release Date Reveal Trailer - XBOX Series X|S
Jump! Warp! The Electro-robo bunny finally hops onto XBOX Series X|S on December 3rd!

Fall Up is a colourful 3D precision platforming adventure filled with vibrant, wildly different worlds, tricky challenges, strange machines, powerful bosses, quirky characters, and plenty of surprises along the way.

With more than 20 hours of content in the first playthrough, there’s plenty to explore, master, and uncover!

The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
🎄 Join the Grinch on a brand-new mission to save Christmas. 

Jump into The Grinch 2: Saving Christmas, a 3D platform adventure where you'll explore magical worlds, collect unique ornaments, and build the ultimate Christmas tree in Who-ville. Grump thump your way through obstacles, dash with Rocket Skates, soar with the Jetpack, and master Grinchy gadgets as you leap through 23 festive levels. Play solo or team up with Max in local co-op for twice the festive fun 🐶 

Coming September 18th to XBOX!
